text: See parent PKIX-lwr9 comment of 2026-05-11. The 'rebaseline limbo' work in this bead would naturally include option (a) from the parent comment — route the limbo CertPath bundle through pkix_path_builder::build_path before classification (mirroring PKIX-t0w4's PKITS harness change). Doing so will flip most of the 47 StricterThanWild bettertls::pathbuilding cases to Agreement automatically and surface the genuine path-builder bugs (probably tc60-shaped). This bead may be the only one of PKIX-lwr9.{2,3,4,5} that needs to land.
